description: Default capabilities for Order Get It Right. The front-end uses only custom commands (get_startup_info, log_command, ping); the three Tauri plugins (shell, dialog, fs) are linked into the binary but their default permissions are NOT granted here. This is the no-network-runtime principle applied to the desktop shell: the front-end cannot exec a process, cannot open an arbitrary URL, and cannot read or write a file outside the Tauri-managed directories. To add a permission, the operator must change this file AND justify it on the chain.
